summary: Our project presents a creative yet scientifically grounded speculative narrative detailing a 20-day global satellite blackout. Leveraging open NASA data sets alongside custom claymation style and video editing tools, we produced a concise, highly engaging storytelling video. This approach allows viewers to easily grasp complex concepts in space science, meteorology, and global natural disasters such as hurricanes and wildfires. The project highlights how vulnerable modern technology can be while showing how people can proactively adapt using traditional backup systems. Audiences not only gain valuable scientific knowledge, but also have a clearer understanding of the importance of space observation, and a fresh perspective on our planet.
details: Our project builds a creative yet scientifically grounded speculative narrative detailing a 20-day global satellite blackout. Leveraging open NASA datasets, it translates global crisis events into a concise, logically structured, and engaging short video story. The project transforms abstract scientific data into an engaging educational video. Its main benefit is inspiring public curiosity, making space science and geography intuitive and accessible for all ages. It deepens public understanding of global natural disasters using NASA data. The project highlights modern technological vulnerabilities, celebrates human adaptability, and raises awareness of the vital role Earth observation satellites play. Our project utilizes editing tools such as Google Vids and CapCut to produce a complete video with engaging voiceover narration. Additionally, we leveraged AI chatbot tools as visual thought-partners to reference claymation character designs and conceptualize realistic environments for our 20-day speculative blackout narrative. Our project demonstrates innovation by transforming complex NASA datasets and raw satellite imagery into an engaging cinematic narrative using a handcrafted claymation visual style. Instead of traditional charts or heavy text, we combine physical storytelling with a compelling 20-day speculative blackout scenario. During production, our main challenge was filtering vast amounts of NASA data to select the most compelling disaster scenarios. By cross-referencing NASA technical documents, satellite logs, and AI-assisted visual concepts, we balanced key elements: accurate data grounding, visually striking claymation motion, logical narrative flow, and a core message celebrating human resilience and planetary stewardship.
